{"type":"function","name":"async","description":"Manage background work started by other tools. wait: block until at least one handle finishes and return every finished one. list: your handles, active by default. status: one handle. stop: end one handle. A start that returned a handle id is still running; collect it with wait in a later call.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["wait","list","status","stop"]},"wait_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"wait: most time to block; 0 polls."},"ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":32,"description":"wait: only these handles. Default: all yours."},"id":{"type":"string","description":"status, stop: handle id."},"state":{"type":"string","enum":["active","done","failed","stopped","timed_out","lost","all"],"description":"list: default active."},"kind":{"type":"string","description":"list: process, subagent, ..."},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"list: page size."},"cursor":{"type":"string","description":"list: from the previous page."}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"skill","description":"Load a skill's instructions by name. Call without a name to list available skills.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"Skill name from the list."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"subagent","description":"Hand a task to a separate agent with its own fresh context and get back only its final answer. Agents only read unless marked [can change files]. Use it for searches or reading that would fill your context. A slow agent returns a run id while it keeps working; never start the task again: use the async tool with that id to wait for it, look at it or stop it. resume continues a finished run of this session as a new run. [can change files; runs to its end] is never handed off. [can change files; may run in the background] is handed off, keeps editing after your turn ends and cannot ask the user: leave its paths alone until it ends.\nAgents:\n- explore: Finds facts.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Self-contained instructions. The agent sees nothing of this conversation. Omit to list the agents."},"agent":{"type":"string","description":"Agent name. Optional when only one is configured."},"resume":{"type":"string","description":"Run id (sub_...) of a finished run of this session to continue from its transcript. The new run is a copy: the old run is not changed, and the result names it as resumed_from."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time this call blocks for the answer; 0 returns a run id at once. Clamped to the async policy. An agent marked [can change files; runs to its end] ignores it and runs to its end."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
